methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $60M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
TS Conductor, a Series B climate and energy company founded by Jason Huang, has raised $60M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (LNZA) in the Climate & Energy sector, including stage-adjacent companies such as KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $60M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $114M. Peer-median analysis relies on three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.0B and a range from $700M to $3.0B. This reflects the wider dispersion observed in frontier energy venture valuations at the Series C stage.

The triangulated analysis across both methods produces a valuation range of $97M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $557M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty inherent in early-stage climate technology valuations: peer comparables span nearly a 5x range, and the stage-progression method assumes standard progression dynamics that may not hold in a sector characterized by heterogeneous technology risk and capital intensity. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peers, technology de-risking trajectory, and the timing and terms of the next financing round.
